in_arabic.name: فُرْقَان
in_arabic.meaning: البَيَان الْحَقِيقِيِّ الَّذِي يُرَدِّدُهُ الْقُرْآنُ عَنِ الرَبِّ

in_urdu.long_meaning: اس کا معنی معانين کا واضح بیان ہے جس سے لوگ حق کو دیکھنے لگتے ہیں جو رب کے عظیم ہونے کا نشانی ہے ۔ یہ بیان رب کے پیار اور مہربانی کا ثبوت ہے اور اس کے حکم اور حکمات کا اظہار ہے ۔ یہ اللہ کا حکیم کلام ہے جس پر لوگ مختلف خیالات رکھتے ہیں اور اس کے ذریعے لوگ اپنی اخلاق کو بہتر بناتے ہیں اور اپنے ایمان کو قائم کرتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: फुर्कान

in_hindi.long_meaning: इसका अर्थ अद्वितीय वास्तविकता का प्रकटीकरण है जिससे लोग भगवान की विशालता को समझने लगते हैं  । यह भगवान के प्रेम और कृपा का प्रमाण है और यह भगवान के आदेशों और न्याय का प्रकटीकरण है  । यह अल्लाह का बुद्धिमान भाषण है जिसके बारे में लोग विभिन्न विचार रखते हैं और जिसके द्वारा वे अपनी मानसिक स्थिति को बेहतर बनाते हैं और अपने ईमान को मजबूत करते हैं

data.cultural_impact: The name "Furqaan" holds immense significance and impact in the Islamic culture. It is a name of Allah (God in Islam) that describes a divine revelation or a source of guidance for the people. In the religious texts, Furqaan is mentioned along with other names of God, and is considered a source of distinction and separation between the truth and falsehood. This name emphasizes the importance of revelation and guidance in the day-to-day lives of Muslims, and serves as a constant reminder to seek knowledge and wisdom from the divine source.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual context, the name "Furqaan" signifies the distinction and separation between the right path and the wrong path. It is a reminder that in a world full of confusion and uncertainty, seeking guidance from the divine source can help us make the right choices and lead a meaningful and purposeful life. The name also encapsulates the concept of Tawhid (the belief in the Oneness of God), emphasizing the importance of following the divinely-revealed path and staying away from falsehood and misguidance. Overall, "Furqaan" is a powerful and inspiring name that holds both cultural and spiritual significance for Muslims, and serves as a constant reminder to seek guidance from the divine source in all aspects of life.
